$comment: What ships in ICOR for Life and what each piece is for: the core keeps the folder working; every optional piece can be removed on its own, and nothing else depends on it. README.md, AGENTS.md and 05 Databases/README.md say the same in words; tests/test-parts.py keeps them in step.

core.name: The numbered folders, AGENTS.md and _System
core.what: where everything lives, how any AI works here, the schema, templates, skills and tools

core.name: Obsidian's own Daily notes, Templates, Properties and Bases
core.what: today's note, new notes from templates, properties, the tables in 05 Databases

core.name: ICOR Objects
core.what: objects from the schema, typed links, the type badge, Connections, the top folder kept clear

core.name: ICOR Journal
core.what: your journal entries as a journal you can browse, and On this day

core.name: ICOR Planner
core.what: your week and your tasks in 06 Planner (the Output stage)

core.name: ICOR Interface
core.what: the folders in their stage colours, where properties show, the look

core.name: ICOR for Life - INKLINE (theme)
core.what: how it all looks; any other theme works, it only looks different

optional.name: ICOR Scratchpad
optional.what: a floating window for today's note or a scratch note, behind a shortcut
optional.remove: Settings, Community plugins: turn off ICOR Scratchpad, then delete its folder .obsidian/plugins/icor-for-life-scratchpad/.
optional.stops: the floating window and its shortcut; Obsidian's Daily notes still opens today

optional.name: ICOR AI Chat
optional.what: a chat with your AI inside the vault
optional.remove: Settings, Community plugins: turn off ICOR AI Chat, then delete its folder .obsidian/plugins/icor-for-life-chat/.
optional.stops: the chat panel; your AI still works with the folder from outside

optional.name: ICOR Connect
optional.what: your app.myicor.com account in the vault: dashboards, search, reflections
optional.remove: Settings, Community plugins: turn off ICOR Connect, then delete its folder .obsidian/plugins/icor-for-life-connect/.
optional.stops: the myICOR dashboards and synced reflections

optional.name: ICOR Focus
optional.what: a map of where your attention goes
optional.remove: Settings, Community plugins: turn off ICOR Focus, then delete its folder .obsidian/plugins/icor-for-life-focus/.

optional.name: ICOR Canvases
optional.what: ink and shapes on canvases, canvases inside canvases
optional.remove: Settings, Community plugins: turn off ICOR Canvases, then delete its folder .obsidian/plugins/icor-for-life-canvases/.
optional.stops: drawing on canvases; Obsidian's own canvases still open

optional.name: ICOR Outliner
optional.what: lists that behave like an outline
optional.remove: Settings, Community plugins: turn off ICOR Outliner, then delete its folder .obsidian/plugins/icor-for-life-outliner/.
optional.stops: moving a bullet with everything under it

optional.name: ICOR PDF Annotation
optional.remove: Settings, Community plugins: turn off ICOR PDF Annotation, then delete its folder .obsidian/plugins/icor-for-life-pdf-annotation/.
optional.stops: highlighting PDFs; the highlight notes you made stay

optional.name: ICOR Terminal
optional.remove: Settings, Community plugins: turn off ICOR Terminal, then delete its folder .obsidian/plugins/icor-for-life-terminal/.

optional.name: ICOR SQLite Viewer
optional.what: opens the SQLite databases in 05 Databases: tables, queries, dashboards
optional.remove: Settings, Community plugins: turn off ICOR SQLite Viewer, then delete its folder .obsidian/plugins/icor-for-life-sqlite-viewer/.
optional.stops: opening the databases in Obsidian; any SQLite tool and your AI still read them

optional.name: Health.sqlite
optional.what: your health data: measurements, workouts, medication, symptoms, mood
optional.remove: Delete 05 Databases/Health.sqlite. To have it again, empty: python3 _System/Tools/new-database.py health.
optional.stops: nothing else; only what you put in it is gone

optional.name: Finance.sqlite
optional.what: your money: accounts, transactions, categories, budgets
optional.remove: Delete 05 Databases/Finance.sqlite. To have it again, empty: python3 _System/Tools/new-database.py finance.
optional.stops: nothing else; only what you put in it is gone
